summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The MicroSectors - 3x Short Brazil ETNs (BRZD) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the VettaFi Brazil Equity Fund-Tracking index. The fund seeks to provide 3x inverse exposure to the daily performance of the VettaFi Brazil Equity Fund Tracking Index. BRZD was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
